text: Hello, boys and girls, how are you today?Nice to see you again.Welcome back to my English class.In this period, we will continue learning Unit 1, Relatives in Beijing.We will focus on writing today.Like fine food, good writing is something we approach with great pleasure and enjoy from the first taste to the last.Good writers are just like good cooks.Today, we are going to learn how to write an informal letter with the topic, planning a trip.Are you ready for the class?Now please get your student's book and your worksheet ready.First of all, I'd like you to look at the picture and think about the questions.Who is in the picture?This is Kitty.What is she doing?She seems to be writing something, right?What is she writing?A letter or a diary?She is writing on a piece of paper.Maybe she's writing a letter.What is she writing about?Maybe she's writing a letter to her friend about the trip in Beijing.But this is just our guess.We don't know the answer for sure.Here's the recording.Please listen and check your prediction.The Li family has come back from Beijing.Kitty enjoyed the trip very much.She is writing a letter to her cousin Lucy.Guys, what is she writing about then?She is writing about the trip in Beijing.Brilliant.I'd like you to look at this letter.Can you find out the problems with it?Please take out your worksheet and do task one.大家,你完成了吗?让我们检查答案您的观点是什么?写字的问题是什么?没有足够的信息正确的是写字没有足够的信息还有什么?写字没有足够的信息还有什么?写字没有足够的信息写字过 1978125125111111111127128129129129141花椒葱蒜蒜花盐生抽白糖梅花盐盐鸡蛋鸡蛋盐鸡蛋千萬記得要按下讚和私訊才可收到郵寄訂閱哦 千萬不要忘記按下鈴鐺哦Is it better?Obviously, it is better than the first letter.Then why?There is more information.Yes, we know why Kitty is writing this letter and the details of the photos.Good.Anything else?It is more polite.Words and expressions like Dear, thank you very much, would you like to, love or show Kitty's politeness, right?You see, it is important to give enough information and show politeness when writing a letter.Now, let's read the letter again.What is each part about?Please read again and match each part with the right description.Now, please take out your worksheet and do task two.Please take out your worksheet and do task two.Now, guys, let's check the answers.What is part A about?Kitty gives thanks to Lucy because of her warm reception, right?How about part B?Kitty tells about the details of the photos.How about part C?Kitty invites Lucy to come to Garden City for a visit.You have a good knowledge about the general idea of Kitty's letter.In Kitty's letter, she mentions the details of the photos.I'd like you to look at these photos and pick out the two photos that Kitty is going to send in her letter.Guys, which two photos?One photo is of Simon and Ben.They are standing on the Great Wall.That will be photo A.Another is a photo of Kitty and Lucy.They are standing in front of an ancient building at the Palace Museum.That will be photo G.You know the details of the photos very well.Sometimes we write a letter to someone close to us.What do we call this kind of letter?An informal letter.And there are several tips here.I'd like you to read Kitty's letter and complete the tips.Please take out your worksheet and do task three.Now let's check the answers.We start the letter with dear and the person's name.In Kitty's letter, we have dear Lucy.And we use some phrases at the beginning of the letter.In Kitty's letter, she writes we had a wonderful time in Beijing.Thank you very much.In other cases, we can also say thank you for your letter, photograph, invitation, etc.In an informal letter, we may also ask questions about an invitation or showing concern for the receiver.In Kitty's letter, she asks would you like to visit us in Garden City for the Spring Festival?And we also finish the letter with politeness.In Kitty's letter, she finishes the letter with love.We use the word when writing to a good friend or close relative.Sometimes we can also use the phrase all the best.Well, so much for the discussion of the format of an informal letter.You see, Ben has also written a similar letter to Simon to invite his family to visit Garden City for the Spring Festival.And Simon has written a letter in reply.Here's the letter.But the sentences are not in the right order.Can you put them into the right order?Now, please take out your worksheet and do task four.Time is up.What should be the right order?Number five, number one, number four, number two, and number three.Guys, you have read Kitty's letter to Lucy.Suppose you are Lucy.How would you write back?I'd like you to write a letter in about 50 words to Kitty.Please include the answers to these questions in your letter.Number one.Number two.Number three.Number four.Number five.And I'd like you to check your letter based on these questions after you finish your letter.Did your letter include the answers to the questions?Did you start and finish the letter correctly?Did you use the phrases in the table to show politeness?Now, please take out your worksheet and do task five.Now, please check your writing.If your letter includes the answers to the questions, a tick.If you start and finish the letter correctly, a tick.If you use the phrases in the table to show politeness, one more tick.Please check your writing.ThankHow many ticks have you got?I hope you all have got three ticks.You see, my student Michelle has finished her letter to Kitty.Let's read and check.We have the information about who, when, length of stay, way of travelling, and the place to visit.That's her complete letter.Can we give her a tick?Did she start and finish the letter correctly?Dear Kitty,Love, Lucy.Yes, a tick.Did she use the phrases in the table to show politeness?Thank you for your letter and invitation.Could you take me there?One more tick.I think Michelle has done a good job.Don't you agree?I believe that you all have done a brilliant job.Today, we learned to write an informal letter with the topic, planning a trip.Thank you for your hard work.I think that you are all good writers.So much for today.Don't forget the whole book.See you next time.Bye-bye.
